title: What Makes the Northern and Southern Lights Glow?
post_title: What Makes the Northern and Southern Lights Glow? | QuantaTale
post_description: Those dancing sky colours begin with charged particles from space. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://science.nasa.gov/sun/auroras/ https://www.swpc.noaa.gov/sites/default/files/images/u33/swx_poster_twosided.pdf #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: Auroras are not ordinary clouds or reflections. The Sun releases a stream of charged particles called the solar wind. Earth's magnetic field guides energy and particles toward regions around the poles. When energetic particles collide with atoms and molecules high in the atmosphere, those gases become excited and release light. Different atmospheric gases and altitudes contribute to different colours. The result is the glowing display known as the northern or southern lights.
